title: feat(invoices): VAT rounding per line
body:
An invoice with mixed VAT rates (20% goods, 5% on the installation line) was computing VAT from the first line's rate applied to the whole net. Reported by the Leeds branch after a customer queried a £38 discrepancy.

VAT is now computed and rounded per line, then summed. Adds a test with two rates on one invoice.
